description: This PHP script handles the saving process for role objects within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves a role bean, updates its fields based on form POST data, manages module relationship permissions, and redirects upon completion.

classes.name: Roles
classes.description: A class representing user roles within SuiteCRM, likely extending from a base Bean class, managing role-specific functionalities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current state of the Roles object to the database.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads role data from the database based on a record ID.

methods.name: clear_module_relationship
methods.description: Removes existing module relationship permissions for the role.

methods.name: set_module_relationship
methods.description: Sets specific module relationship permissions for the role.
